US Halts Green Card Process for Indian IT Firms; Executives Share Experiences

The United States has paused the PERM (Program Electronic Review Management) process for Indian IT firms, a move that has prompted discussions among executives. Anupam Mittal shared that he had previously returned his green card, a decision he stated allowed him to build businesses and support startups in India. He noted that recent pauses in green card processing for Indian IT firms present an opportunity. Meanwhile, Infosys and TCS have stated that the suspension will have no material impact, with TCS citing low application numbers.
